role: DEVELOPMENT physical injection-recovery, not final validation

limitations: Synthetic solar-star transit population, not actual planet radii or stellar models.

Injected trials with no in-sector sampled transit remain in denominator.

Empirical noise-only false-alarm rate is NOT reported.
